The old skill happened to take only one screenshot here because the document was already prepared (no scratch build needed) and the edit was small. Under the old guidance ('screenshot after each meaningful chunk'), a multi-chunk edit would have produced more screenshots — the eval measures default behavior, and the old behavior just got lucky on this small edit.

The key behavioral difference: with_skill chose snapshot_layout BEFORE the screenshot as default verification (correct ladder). old_skill defaulted to screenshot, then reached for snapshot_layout only as a diagnostic when the screenshot raised a question. Same final tool set, wrong order — and on a more complex edit, the old order means more screenshots.
The grader is being strict on the ordering assertion — this is the assertion that distinguishes the new ladder discipline from the old screenshot-first reflex.
